content.user_title: Manage GKE Clusters with Expert Guidance
content.value_statement: GKE work spans setup, deployment, security, scaling, and troubleshooting. This skill gives structured commands, patterns, and checks for reliable GKE operations.
actual_capabilities: Guides users through GKE Autopilot and Standard cluster creation.
Provides deployment, service, ingress, and autoscaling examples.
Explains Workload Identity setup with service account binding steps.
Lists kubectl troubleshooting commands for pods, services, resources, and events.
Summarizes production patterns for HTTPS ingress, disruption budgets, security contexts, and cost controls.
limitations: Does not inspect live clusters unless the host agent has configured GCP and Kubernetes access.
Commands use placeholders and require user-specific project, cluster, region, and workload values.
Does not replace official GKE support for outages, billing disputes, or compliance sign-off.
May require current Google Cloud documentation for newly released GKE features.

use_cases.title: Prepare a production deployment
use_cases.description: Plan cluster type, manifests, ingress, scaling, identity, and validation steps before releasing a service on GKE.

use_cases.title: Troubleshoot failed workloads
use_cases.description: Build a focused investigation path for pods, services, events, resources, and logs in a GKE cluster.

use_cases.title: Plan cost and scaling changes
use_cases.description: Compare autoscaling, Autopilot, Spot VMs, requests, limits, and monitoring signals for cost-aware operations.

prompt_templates.title: Create a GKE starter plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose Autopilot or Standard for a new GKE cluster. Ask for missing project, region, environment, and workload details first.

prompt_templates.title: Deploy a containerized app
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a GKE deployment checklist for my app image IMAGE and service port PORT. Include manifests, commands, validation, and rollback steps.

prompt_templates.title: Troubleshoot a failing service
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this GKE issue: PASTE SYMPTOMS. Build a step-by-step troubleshooting path and list likely root causes.

prompt_templates.title: Review production readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my GKE architecture for production readiness. Cover identity, autoscaling, ingress, security context, disruption budgets, monitoring, and cost controls.

output_examples.input: I need to deploy a web app on GKE.
output_examples.output: A cluster choice recommendation, deployment checklist, service exposure plan, validation steps, and rollback notes.

output_examples.input: My pods are stuck in Pending.
output_examples.output: A troubleshooting path covering events, node capacity, quotas, requests, scheduling constraints, and practical fixes.

output_examples.input: We need Workload Identity for an app.
output_examples.output: An identity mapping plan, required accounts, permission checks, binding sequence, and verification tasks.

best_practices: Confirm cluster type, region, environment, and workload criticality before applying guidance.
Review generated commands before running them against production clusters.
Use least-privilege IAM and Workload Identity for application access to Google Cloud.
anti_patterns: Running placeholder commands without replacing project, cluster, region, and workload values.
Using shell access to pods as a normal workflow instead of fixing deployment observability.
Applying autoscaling or cleanup commands to production without change review.

faq.question: Can this skill create a GKE cluster for me?
faq.answer: It can draft commands and plans. Execution depends on the host agent and your authenticated Google Cloud environment.

faq.question: Does it support Autopilot and Standard clusters?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for Autopilot clusters and Standard clusters with node autoscaling.

faq.question: Can it troubleshoot live Kubernetes workloads?
faq.answer: It can guide evidence collection and analysis. Live troubleshooting requires cluster access and user approval for commands.

faq.question: Does it cover GKE security features?
faq.answer: It includes Workload Identity guidance and security context examples. Use official documentation for full compliance reviews.

faq.question: Can beginners use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. Start with cluster type, environment, region, and workload goals so the guidance can stay specific.

faq.question: Is this a replacement for Google Cloud documentation?
faq.answer: No. It organizes common GKE workflows and links to official documentation for deeper reference.
